critique: The central palette and small amount of fiery texture are closer to fire, but the result still reads as a compact spark burst rather than Hazy Fire. At t1 the core is overly white and crowded with discrete yellow ember dots; by t4 those dots have expanded into a broad, nearly radial field. The desired sustained, soft smoke volume and coherent upward/billowing flame shape are still absent.

suggestions.why: Greatly reduce particle travel so the emission stops reading as an explosion and remains concentrated as a lingering fire volume.
Suppress the wide all-direction velocity variation responsible for the radial halo of detached embers.
Add substantial air resistance so particles billow and hang near the flame rather than continuing to eject outward.
Lengthen lifetime to build persistent layered haze instead of short-lived sparks.
Maximize particle softness to dissolve the visible circular ember edges into smoke-like fire haze.
Use non-additive blending to reduce the clipped white-hot core and preserve orange/red flame detail.
